conclusions: The caption byte stream is the RU charmap index sequence (verified: ВКЛ -> 37 40 50).
The caption renderer maps byte value -> Unicode code point with the same number, i.e. it uses a font whose glyph order is identity/Latin-1, not the RU charmap order.
Cyrillic fonts are available and used by the game's own labels in the same frame.
Therefore the fix is not a different encoding and not adding Cyrillic to the mod's ImGui fonts: the mod's caption elements must be drawn with the RU-localized menu font.

fonts_ru.bin: alias 'menu' has no resource path in RU (33 strings) while US has one (34 strings: font\font_metro_for_menu_us). 'stats' and 'typewriter' lack a path in both locales, so 'menu' is the only RU-specific hole.

Working model: mod caption elements resolve to 'menu' or to the engine default; in RU 'menu' is broken and falls back to a 256-entry identity-order font. Needs static confirmation in 0x9b3a0 / 0x91440 / 0x958d0.
